gameDissections.evidenceSummary: In G01 (00:30 CST, mode=5 map=10 931x959, L_map=546,152, 6 teams, end t=5858), all 8 bots spawned in a tight northeastern edge strip (x in [690,906], y in [16,466], minSep=101px) after 3 early voronoi=500 island fallback events. Due to V2 compression, 3 bots (kevin_k 14,712, dave_w 12,386, ethan21 6,403; total 33,501 land) were completely walled in (nb=0), andTeam 4 held 104,930 land (19.21% < 22% line) at t=1530. From t=1720 to t=4230, 6 coastal bots hit 'TypeError: rnd is not a function' in tryClaimNearTeamIslands (404996d bug), inadvertently hoarding 11,219,234 troops (d_team=92.3) by t=4320 when [HOT-IMPORT] injected 917e6b1. Immediately upon waking at t=4320->4500, V7 (oppFloorCap=38, keep<=10~26*L, totB=B+myOut) caused our frontline to dump 5.33M troops in 180 ticks (ryan_m bal 3.86M->605k, dens 107.5->14.6). Although Team 4 reached #1 in the match (151,096 land at t=5040~5139, with ryan_m peaking at 51,217, noah88 at 28,284, leo_tx at 19,686), at t=5040 ryan_m fired 13 commands in 90 ticks to drain his own density to 7.1 (bal=356,539 on 50,549 land) and leo_tx drained to 9.9, while boxed-in kevin_k (1.05M troops, d=71.5) and ethan21 (473k troops, d=73.8) were deadlocked from squad-rescue donating by coastGuardFloor=68*L and dMe>=106. Team 6 (Ottoman empire / COLD) breached our d=7.1 frontline and wiped all 8 bots between t=5139 and t=5858.

variableEvaluations.currentValue: Across all 10 live games (G00-G09) in tsb-team-squad.log, 7/10 games (70%) suffered severe V1 failures: 6 games (G00, G02, G04, G05, G07, G09) spawned 2~7 bots on tiny islands (5px to 30,481px) with 18/77 final bot spawns (and 208 countdown solves) hitting the voronoi=500 fallback; 1 game (G06, map=24) anchored all 8 bots on the 190,201px secondary continent (53.75% of the 353,876px main continent, which STILL passes d590acd's >=45% filter!), gifting the 353,876px main continent to Team 4.
variableEvaluations.baseline80PctValue: Anchored on #1 largest main continent with SPOILER_BANK 2-bot pair on secondary continents >=18% map land and <=4 enemies.
variableEvaluations.recommendedOptimalValue: Raise minAnchorContSize in findVirtualSquadAnchor from 0.45*maxCompSize to 0.75*maxCompSize (strictly locking anchor to continents[0]), require 8-directional openness openDirs(r=96px) >= 4, replace duplicate 1.18x hasEdgeBackstop multiplier with (0.72 + 0.06*openDirs), and enable targetFlankCount = K>=5 ? 2 : 1 around anchorBoss.
variableEvaluations.causalMechanism: In pre-d590acd autonomous games, unpopulated islands had dComp=1,000,000 (max clearance=220), attracting VirtualSquadAnchor in 60% of matches and triggering a deadlock between compSize<minViableCompSize and dBoss<0 that forced 23.4% of live spawns into the voronoi=500 fallback. Even after d590acd (>=45% maxCompSize), maps like map=24 (G06) have a secondary continent at 53.75% of maxCompSize, trapping all 8 bots on 25% of map land via aa1384b's strict bossCompId filter.

variableEvaluations.causalMechanism: Tightening allyMinSep to <=112px and clusterMax to <=350px in fd868f3 reduced average t=1500 team land across 30 real maps by -28% (from 93,738px / 21.33% share to 67,705px / 16.51% share, slashing the >=22% dominant opening rate from 30.4% to 10.9%) and boxed in 2~3 inner bots per game (in G01: kevin_k, dave_w, ethan21). Worse, boxed-in bots touching exterior water (hasExposedCoast=true -> isPureInlandSafe=false) get capped at dMe=70~78 by surplus donate and coastGuardFloor=68*L, so they never reach the dMe>=106 required by squad rescue donate, stranding 1.52M+ troops in G01 while the frontline died at d=7.1.

topCoreVariableRanking.oneLineReason: In G01, oppFloorCap=38 + keep<=10~26*L + totB=B+myOut caused frontline bots to dump 5.33M troops in 180 ticks (t=4320->4500) and drained ryan_m (51.2k land) to dens=7.1 at t=5040.
In 7/10 live games (G00,G02,G04,G05,G06,G07,G09), VirtualSquadAnchor picked tiny islands (48~50 voronoi=500 fallbacks) or secondary continents (G06 190k vs 354k main continent).
fd868f3's allyMinSep<=112px & clusterMax<=350px cut t=1500 team land by -28% (0/9 multi-team games reached >=22% land at t=1530) and boxed in 3 bots in G01 with 2.02M stranded troops.
Boxed-in coastal teammates (kevin_k 1.05M, ethan21 473k in G01) had isPureInlandSafe=false, deadlocking squad rescue donate (requires dMe>=106) below coastGuardFloor=68*L.
